org.portico.impl.cpp1516e

Class ProxyRtiAmbassador

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.impl.cpp1516e.ProxyRtiAmbassador

  • public class ProxyRtiAmbassador
extends Object
    This class is provided as the simplified JNI link to C++ code in the interface binding. When a new "JavaRTI" is created in the C++ binding, it instantiates a new instance of this class. The methods provided by this class are simplified versions of those provided in the RTIambassdor. They pass basic primitive types in an effort to make the JNI code on the C++ side simpler.

    Inside this class is an actual Java RTIambassador, with calls to the methods of this class being translated approprirately before being passed to it.

    The Federate Ambassador

    When a new proxy is created and the C++ side attempts to join a federation, passing a reference to its FederateAmbassador, that reference will NOT be passed over the JNI boundary. Rather, an ID representing the C++ JavaRTI instance will be provided, and a new ProxyFederateAmbassador} created with that ID. When the local java proxy receives callbacks, it passes them over the JNI boundary with the ID so that on the C++ side we can locate the associated JavaRTI, and through it, the C++ FederateAmbassador. The callback is then made.

      • parseCppRid

        public static boolean parseCppRid()
        This method is only to be called from the C++ side of the bindings.

        It will search for the RID file and load its contents into the system properties. If the environment variable RTI_RID_FILE is set, it will look for the RID file in that location. If there is a value in that location, it will attempt to load that file. If the file can be found, it will be loaded as a properties file. If it can't be found, the method will try to load ./RTI.rid (where the current directory is the directory from which the program was launched. If that file can't be found, the method will just return.

        Returns:
        true if a file was loaded, false otherwise
